text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A collection of precious race films accumulated over time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend rewatched
the whole thing once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oryo? I had Trainy take photos mostly focusing on my rivals, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There are so many unexpected scenes. With all this,
couldn't we totally make a spin-off?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, one day, I was called over—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan.
An exclusive sneak peek just for you!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
An emotional highlight reel collecting only my finest moments
from all the footage saved up. An epic tearjerker with zero documentary value.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the video footage that appeared on the screen—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Transcend dashes, dashes, out in front!
She conquers the Kashiwa Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
At Funabashi Racecourse, home turf of her rival Furioso,
she showed us a magnificent battle.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Transcend closes out the year as well,
conquering the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hats off to both Smart Falcon and Wonder Acute. This year's star on the dirt was without a doubt Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Kawasaki Kinen, the February Stakes,
the Kashiwa Kinen, the Teio Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mile CS Nambu Hai, JBC Classic,
Champions Cup, Tokyo Daishoten."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a digest of the glorious feat of claiming
8 G1 victories in a single year.
Just watching it brought tears to my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Trainy, are you tearing up by any chance?
choice_data_list: Of course. What about you, Tran?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm not crying at all!
I already cried my eyes out while editing by myself.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Hey, hey, since we have it,
why don't we do a special release of this video?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that maybe
someone out there might want it."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!
It's an assortment of super emo videos of yours truly—enjoyed by absolutely no one!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, there's surprisingly a lot of them?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Transcend is now the undisputed leader of dirt racing. The rather generous batch of discs I burned is selling out one after another."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it'd be pathetic if nobody came,
so I just came to take some off your hands!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I accept with gratitude.
I'll watch it over and over
to fuel my fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of watching it together
with Tarumae-chan and Rickey-chan, the three of us~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay, they swapped their ROM with mine!
It's so fun checking out each other's stuff♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Trai-chan, we're almost out of stock.
...Though, maybe we made a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There are about five left over, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll take everything, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume super-fan who can run on both turf and dirt took home everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One for personal use, one to preserve, and one for evangelism.
Plus a personal copy 2, and a personal copy 3.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Man, that was super popular! That was all thanks to your camera skills, Trai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What should I do?
Maybe become a movie director in the future?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If you're not gonna be a movie director,
what kind of job do you wanna do in the future, Trainie?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Will you stick to being a Trainer?
Or maybe a different job related to Umamusume?
choice_data_list: Who knows? Might be a completely different gig.
Who knows? Might be a completely different gig.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's a chance she won't stay in this circle forever.
She might end up living somewhere far away."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so there's a chance they could end up
somewhere totally unrelated to us?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend stared blankly
at the ceiling for a while, and then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Just stay, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Her disappearing would be boring.
I really wouldn't want that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You don't even have to stay a Trainer if you don't want to.
But still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Just stay, forever. Lazing around right here.
...Alright?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Transcend's brilliant success,
I too gained great recognition as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thought crosses my mind. Perhaps there's a future where
I continue working in some capacity
here at Tracen Academy.
